title: やゆよ・やま と ゆき
jp: や行 ・ gojuon row 8 (short row) ・ nature
blurb: Row 8 of the gojuon — や ゆ よ — a SHORT row (three kana), through the outdoors: a tall mountain and a riverside willow, white snow and a red sunset, a lily in the garden, a starry night sky and a four-leaf clover. A calm nature variation of three や-row songs.
concept: や行 is a short row — three kana (や ゆ よ; い/え borrowed from あ行) — so this is 3 groups of 3 words (9 targets), refrain や ゆ よ, and a naturally shorter song.

Words alone blend (findings F-10), so every target sits in a small image — かわ の やなぎ, ほし の よぞら — recombining earlier rows (かわ, にわ, ほし, はる return; F-13). Row closes every verse (F-07); the longer cut adds a bridge + review, not a loop (F-12).
This is the nature variation — the calm one, for koto × modern. や行 is rich in seasonal nature (やなぎ, ゆき, ゆうやけ, よぞら). Pairs with the Male (koto) voice.
